bio_en: Aharon Sachaklian was born in Malatya on 8 September 1879, the son of the architect Artin Sachaklian, who died when he was three months old. In summer 1896 his elder brother brought him to America; on the way, in Marseille, he met Mkrtich Portukalian, who urged him to continue his studies without forgetting his nation, faith and language. For more than half a century he was a prominent ARF figure in America, involved in the community's national and party questions and in efforts toward a national union in 1917-18.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Not a fighter; death year not read (article c. 1964).
